digest.component_or_area: Jira reconciler rich-text codec (Cloud ADF + Data Center wiki)
propositions: Cloud Markdown descriptions and comments must encode as structured ADF (not plain-text paragraphs) through production codec paths.
Data Center safe Markdown descriptions and comments must render as native Jira wiki markup (not literal source) through production codec paths, with fallback to identity when pandoc is absent.
Echo-safety layer using per-binding baselines and change-gated rich_sha must prevent round-trip content loss and suppress unchanged re-emits across Markdown↔ADF↔wiki conversions.
Jira-authored constructs (panels, mentions, dates) must survive rebar-originated reconcile passes via origin-gated outbound normalization.
Bidirectional sync must detect and flag concurrent local+remote edits using three-way baseline/local/remote comparison (last-write-wins with conflict markers).
Comment creation must use append-only Jira-comment-ID mapping and route through the same rich-text codec as descriptions, with no edit/delete sync.
